replies.author: NotPineapple203
replies.body:
Well the moon is currently in the waning gibbous phase, which last seven days. Thailand is seven hours ahead of GMT. Thailand has eight letters. You know what else has eight letters? Augustus, the son of Julius Caesar. You know what was named after Augustus? The month of august. From this we can certify that Atlas will come out in August.

Now that we have narrowed down to the month august we need to figure out the year. Let's look at the name. ATLAS. 5 letters. Five is the unlucky number of the horse (Chinese Astrology). Horses have four feet and there are 5 letters in horse. 4 * 5 = 20 . Horses also have 2 eyes. This means that the digits 2 and 0 are the first two digits in the year atlas comes out, respectively. now we just need the last two. Horses have 4 legs and a four chambered heart. 4 * 4 = 16. We now have the year atlas will come out. 2016.

Now we just need to figure out the day. Lets look at minecraft. minecraft is a game were the maximum number of blocks you can have is 64. 8 is the square root of 64. Minecraft has 9 letters and Atlas has 5. 9 - 5 = 4. 4 * 8 = 32. We now know the day of the month that atlas comes out and with that we can conclude that...









ATLAS WILL COME OUT ON AUGUST 32, 2016 C.E.
